problem.title: Minimum Operations to Reduce Array to Zero
problem.problemStatement: Given an array of non-negative integers, in one operation you may choose a positive value x and subtract x from every positive element in the array. Determine the minimum number of operations required to make every element zero.
problem.input: • First line contains integer N. • Second line contains N non-negative integers.
problem.output: Print the minimum number of operations.
